title: 52 - Bullwinkle
summary: At [[location:epsilon-eridani]], [[character:bill]] is touring [[location:ee-2|Ragnarök]] in [[technology:bullwinkle]], which no longer needs a drone trailing it, when [[character:garfield]] brings the report from [[location:82-eridani]] after the [[event:second-battle-at-82-eridani|second battle]]: three likely colony targets pending biocompatibility checks, wreckage that [[character:loki]] is studying for its cloaking, and unexploded fission bombs that a [[technology:suddar|SUDDAR]] pulse might scan safely. Bill still fears the sheer numbers of the [[species:others|Others]]. At the moot in the pub, [[character:monty]] reports that underwater defenses are deterring the krakens at [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-3|Poseidon]] and that he wants to leave once the colony can stand on its own, while Bobs quiz [[character:riker]] about Earth. Bill notes [[character:howard]]'s absence and worries that newer Bobs are tiring of humans. [[character:marvin]] and [[character:luke]] hear that [[character:bender]] is still silent and that [[character:victor]] found nothing along his vector, and they plan an expedition to follow the thinned-gas trail his ship would have left.

updates.current_state: At [[location:epsilon-eridani]] he tours [[location:ee-2|Ragnarök]] in [[technology:bullwinkle]], which no longer needs a trailing drone but is still far from human size. Given [[character:garfield]]'s 82 Eridani report, he fears the Others' numbers; at the moot he worries newer Bobs tire of humans.

At [[location:epsilon-eridani]] he brings [[character:bill]] the [[location:82-eridani]] report: three likely colony targets pending biocompatibility checks, wreckage [[character:loki]] is studying for cloaking, and unexploded fission bombs to scan with a V4 [[technology:suddar|SUDDAR]] pulse.

At [[location:eta-cassiopeiae-3|Poseidon]], new underwater defenses are slowly deterring the krakens after some bad months, and the floating-city plans go ahead. He means to leave once the colony has enough infrastructure and redundancy, having had enough of shepherding humans.

At the moot he asks [[character:bill]] for news of his cohort-mate [[character:bender]], still in vain. With [[character:luke]] he plans an expedition to trace Bender from his heading on leaving [[location:delta-eridani-4|Eden]], following the thinned-gas trail a Heaven vessel leaves.

Nearly thirty years after he and [[character:bender]] left [[location:delta-eridani]], he joins [[character:marvin]] at the moot to plan an expedition after Bender: a Heaven vessel's scooping leaves slightly thinner gas along its path, so even a mid-flight course change can be followed.

Still silent nearly thirty years after leaving [[location:delta-eridani]]; [[character:bill]] thinks something most likely happened to him. [[character:victor]] found nothing along his departure vector, and [[character:marvin]] and [[character:luke]] are planning an expedition to trace his trail.

Following [[character:bender]]'s departure vector, he has found nothing so far and thinks Bender may have changed course along the way. He is unwilling to backtrack, so [[character:marvin]] and [[character:luke]] are thinking of mounting their own search.

At [[location:82-eridani]] after the [[event:second-battle-at-82-eridani|second battle]], he has [[technology:hunter-seekers]] sweeping the system and is studying the destroyed vessels' wreckage, which he hopes will show how the enemy's cloaking works.

updates.state: [[character:ernesto-medeiros|Medeiros]]' forces were cleared by [[character:loki]]'s squad, and [[technology:hunter-seekers]] sweep the system. By December the survey points to three new colony targets pending biocompatibility checks, and the wreckage and unexploded fission bombs are under study.

Its first colony lives on two plant mats in the north tropical current, with colonists from Micronesia, the Maldives, Vanuatu and Saint Lucia. After bad months of kraken visits, new underwater defenses are deterring them; floating cities are planned.
